name: The Way of the Hunter
summary: Young hunters in Thendal Grove begin training after driving back the local vuldren. Now Rorian the Dayseeker summons them to meet Tai'ree Farsight and begin formal tutelage.

sections.title: A Summons to the Hunt
sections.body: After thinning the disruptive vuldren on Thendal Grove's outskirts, young hunters return to find their practical skills have drawn attention. Rorian the Dayseeker gives them a scribbled summons from Tai'ree Farsight, the grove's resident hunter trainer. For novice rangers preparing to explore Zephras Isle, the meeting turns their work from defending the island to learning martial skills and survival.

sections.title: The Tutelage of Tai'ree
sections.body: Near the center of the village, Tai'ree Farsight welcomes promising pupils with stern realism. Thriving in untamed nature demands sharp senses and lightning reflexes. Her guidance comes from her long years of experience, giving island trackers a foundation for honing their marksmanship and survival skills.

aliases: who gives the way of the hunter
faq.answer: After you help Rorian the Dayseeker with the local vuldren infestation in 'Harmony in Balance', he offers this training in thendal grove on zephras isle.
Tai'ree Farsight is the resident hunter trainer near the center of Thendal Grove. She oversees the training and discipline of aspiring marksmen and island trackers.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Scribbled Note?
faq.answer: The Scribbled Note is a message Tai'ree Farsight leaves while you are away dealing with the vuldren. It directs you to seek her out in the village square to begin advanced training.

faq.q: Where does this quest take place?
faq.answer: This takes place entirely within Thendal Grove, an outpost settlement on Zephras Isle.

faq.q: What prerequisite must be completed before this quest?
aliases: prereq for the way of the hunter
faq.answer: Before meeting Tai'ree, you must complete 'Harmony in Balance' for Rorian the Dayseeker. There, you prove your initial competence by dealing with the aggressive vuldren near the grove.

faq.q: What does Tai'ree Farsight teach new hunters?
faq.answer: Tai'ree Farsight acts as your class trainer. Speaking with her introduces the core philosophy of island tracking and opens access to foundational hunter abilities and combat techniques.

angles.text: As a hunter on Zephras Isle, you begin formal training under Tai'ree Farsight.
